# Siva Dheeraj

> Siva Dheeraj (Siva Dheeraj Ethamsetti) is a full-stack developer and founding engineer / technical lead at Applied Work (appliedwork.ai), an AI data and compute company. He builds LLM systems, RAG pipelines, agent evaluation tooling, GTM automation and web products. Based in Surat, India.
